'''Amar''',<ref name="CSWE" /> also known as '''Amara''',<ref name="Gamer1">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref> was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Amaran/Legends|Amaran]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Amar system/Legends|Amar system]].

==History==
As of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] reign, the native Amaran had a colony on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where they found jobs as merchants and salesbeings.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amar was originally first mentioned in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> A comment by [[Daniel Wallace]], one of the co-authors of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] of [[TheForce.net]] later revealed that Amar was considered to be the same as "Amara"<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30380546|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Daniel Wallace|Dan Wallace]]|PTtime=[[August 26]], [[2009]], 10:09/10:11am|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180629234238/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-103#post-30380546}}</ref> that had previously been mentioned in the article "[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series]]," which was written by [[Rich Handley]] and [[Joseph Bongiorno|Joe Bongiorno]] and published in<ref name="Gamer1" /> the [[November]] [[2000]]<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars Gamer Special Edition]]''</ref> [[Star Wars Gamer 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine.<ref name="Gamer1" />
